MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 16
   C. 9
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

====

1. B — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 16 − 7

Final Answer: x = 9
